summary: Iteration-3 backend re-test after fix to POST /api/workflows/{id}/start (now invokes advance_process and returns {process, advanced}). All 31 backend tests PASS (100%), including the three E2E engine flows: above-threshold finance routing, below-threshold finance skip, and rejection short-circuit. Iteration-1 regression suite (auth, dashboard, forms CRUD, workflows CRUD/start, processes, comments, tasks, AI SSE streaming) all green.

minor.issue: Still accepts draft workflows (no status='published' guard). Low impact but recommended for production.
workflow=null is still possible if the underlying workflow is deleted (no cascade). Carried over from iter-1; not regressed.

action_items: (Optional/non-blocking) Add 400 guard in start_workflow when workflow.status != 'published'.
(Optional/non-blocking) Cascade or soft-handle deleted workflows in GET /api/processes/{pid}.
Frontend polish (carried over): Persian Jalali date picker in FormRenderer; rfInstance.fitView() on WorkflowBuilder mount; ReactFlowProvider wrapper. Not part of this re-test.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: server.start_workflow now calls await advance_process(process_id=instance.id, completed_node_id=first_node['id']) and returns {process, advanced}. Trigger node correctly seeds the engine frontier.

Response shape change from flat instance dict to {process, advanced} is a breaking change for any external consumer; tests updated. Frontend WorkflowsList must read body.process.id (verify in next FE pass).

advance_process correctly evaluates the conditional edge on n3→n4 (op='>', value='5000000') against context['amount'] coerced from form_data submitted by employee — both branches (above & below threshold) verified.
Rejection branch in PATCH /api/tasks short-circuits process.status='rejected' and skips advance_process; verified — no downstream tasks created on rejection.
test_credentials: admin@raahkar.ir/admin1234, designer@raahkar.ir/1234, manager@raahkar.ir/1234, employee@raahkar.ir/1234 — all working.
seed_data_creation: Re-used existing seed (3 forms incl. tabs form, 2 workflows incl. تنخواه with conditional edge). E2E tests create transient process_instances and tasks but do not pollute base seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Engine E2E flows are now exercised end-to-end in test_iter2.py::TestEngineE2E (above-threshold, below-threshold, rejection). Response shape of POST /api/workflows/{id}/start is now {process, advanced} — confirm frontend WorkflowsList 'اجرا' button reads the new shape. _start_petty helper now asserts advanced.next_tasks is non-empty as a regression guard for the iter-2 critical bug.
rca of the issue: Previous iter-2 critical bug fully resolved. Root cause was start_workflow not invoking advance_process from the trigger node; fix adds the call and merges next_tasks into a wrapper response. Verified via three independent E2E scenarios that exercise the conditional edge evaluator, the standard-edge fallthrough, and the rejection short-circuit.
